The '''Griren Province''' was located on the<ref name="Choices" /> [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Hapor system/Legends|Hapor system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hapor]].<ref name="Choices" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of both [[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']] and ''[[Choices of One]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]]. The latter is set three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the former and also places the [[Water/Legends|water]] dispute on [[Hapor]] within that interval of [[Time/Legends|time]].</ref> the [[Hand of Judgment]], a team of five [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Desertion/Legends|deserters]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], participated in a lesser [[Water/Legends|water]] dispute in the province. Within three [[Standard month/Legends|months]] of the dispute, [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] read a report on the Hand of Judgment's involvement in the event.<ref name="Choices" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Griren Province was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]].<ref name="Choices" />
